props.caption: The model is one replaceable part; the loop, tools, log and sandbox sit on the same plugin tree.

items.note: The Danube fell through Unit 2’s operating threshold, leaving both reactors safely offline.
Taiwan confirmed an overseas hybrid intrusion; the detailed agent kill chain remains a vendor reconstruction.
DeepSeek released V4-Pro beside an MIT runtime whose agent loop, tools and sandbox are plugins.
Five days of weather and power interruption forced Antofagasta to narrow its copper promise.
Oklahoma and Tennessee completed executions while Alabama’s warrant window remained open for a later proceeding.
Police put the ferry death toll at 46; the full manifest and formal causal finding remained open.

items.what: A traveller from Isiro died in Buta, extending the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak into a sixth Congolese province. Africa CDC says most new cases are appearing outside monitored contacts, turning the contact list and unpaid response workforce into the containment problem.

items.kicker: Zambia Moves the Election Into the Count
items.what: Voting closed with 8,786,300 people on the register and isolated late-opening stations due extra time. No national turnout or presidential result existed at cutoff, so the next test is whether station totals reach the national count without the procedural friction becoming a pattern.

items.kicker: Putin Steps Onto the Unfinished Treaty
items.what: Vladimir Putin made his first visit to Iturup, which Japan calls Etorofu, and Tokyo summoned Russia’s ambassador in protest. The island dispute still blocks a postwar peace treaty, giving one trip the weight of an unfinished 1945 settlement.

items.kicker: Kariba’s Manifest Still Does Not Close
items.what: Zimbabwean police raised the Lake Kariba ferry death toll to 46 and the government declared a disaster. Passenger estimates remained inconsistent and no inspectable manifest or formal cause had settled whether loading, weather, vessel condition or several failures decided the loss.

items.kicker: Orsk’s Repair Clock Outlives the Drone
items.what: Orenburg’s governor said Ukraine’s strike could keep the six-million-tonne-a-year Orsk refinery shut for as long as six months. That is an early repair estimate; sanctions and imported-equipment dependence are the mechanism that could make the damage last longer than the attack.

items.kicker: A Union Forms Around the Memory Line
items.what: About 2,500 SK hynix workers launched a cross-category union across a Korean workforce of roughly 35,000. It has no majority bargaining status and no production impact yet, but HBM’s factory bottleneck now has a labor threshold worth watching.

Ofwat provisionally backed £3.4 billion of added projects across 13 water companies, with five seeking near-term recovery through customer bills. The consultation decides which demand surprises, including housing and data-centre loads, customers finance before the next price review.

Youibot presented FabriGym as a scan-to-simulation pipeline for training industrial robots before site deployment. The architecture attacks the repeated commissioning problem; its claimed move from months to days still lacks an independent customer test.

items.kicker: Lala Leaves Hawaiʻi a Short Forecast
items.what: Tropical Storm Lala approached Hawaiʻi County with a forecast peak just below hurricane strength and little warning runway. The operational question is whether the track, not another category label, brings damaging wind and rain onto the island.

items.kicker: Nine Officials Leave Without a Reason
items.what: The Dominican Republic ordered nine Cuban officials to leave and did not publish the conduct that triggered the expulsions. The diplomatic act is established; motive remains a blank that neither government had filled by cutoff.
